objectives.title: Controller Instruction Adherence
objectives.description: The contract contains writings governing personal data processing strictly upon documented instructions from the controller.
criteria: Clauses limiting the processor's own data processing strictly to instructions received from the controller.
Clauses binding personnel or agents acting under the processor's authority who access personal data to the same instruction-only limitation.
Clauses binding personnel or agents acting under the controller's own authority (not the processor's) who access personal data to the same instruction-only limitation.

objectives.title: Statutory Compliance Exceptions
objectives.description: The contract contains writings governing personal data processing mandated by external legislation.
criteria: Clauses recognizing processing required by Union law.
Clauses recognizing processing required by Member State law.
Provisions governing processing duties superseding controller instructions.
